biotools.summary: Create side-by-side visualizations of tissue thumbnail image and HoverNet cell segmentation with colored cell type labels. Functionality automatically retrieves the thumbnail image associated with a HoverNet JSON file and overlays the segmentation data. This package is intended for researchers working with histopathological images, facilitating exploratory analysis, and integrates with the imageFeatureTCGA Bioconductor package.
